# Vibe Voyager — Build Memory

## Current State (as of Phase 5 completion)
- **Phases 1-5 COMPLETE** — Scaffolding, Infrastructure, Core Screens, Game Systems, Mini-Games
- **22 commits, ~7,000 lines of code, 19 agent invocations, 0 type errors**
- **Next: Phase 6+7** — Planet Content (8 planets × mission data) + Academy (10 sections)

## What's Built
- Title screen, character creation, cockpit HUD, star map, navigation bar
- Dialogue system, mission framework (4-phase: briefing→learning→challenge→debrief)
- Inventory & crew pages
- 5 mini-games: PromptDuel, Architect, Connect, Debug, Command
- All game state in localStorage via React context

## What's Left
- **Phase 6:** Fill 34 mission content files (dialogue trees, learning blocks, challenge data) — 8 parallel agents
- **Phase 7:** Academy section content (10 sections of real-world guides)
- **Phase 8:** Polish (page transitions, audio integration, responsive, visual assets)
- **Phase 9:** Vercel deployment

## Key Architecture
- Mission data in `lib/data/missions.ts` — 34 mission stubs with empty content arrays
- Each planet needs a content file at `lib/data/missions/[planetId].ts`
- Mini-games accept `onComplete(score: 0-100)` and are wired via mission `challengeType`
- Mission page at `app/planets/[planetId]/mission/[missionId]/page.tsx` has placeholder challenge phase

## File Map
- `app/` — pages (page.tsx, create/, cockpit/, starmap/, planets/[planetId]/, inventory/, crew/)
- `components/ui/` — 7 reusable components (GlassPanel, Button, StarfieldBackground, TypewriterText, StatGauge, XPBar)
- `components/game/` — DialogueSystem, MissionBriefing, LearningPhase, MissionDebrief, NavBar, StarMap
- `components/games/` — PromptDuel, Architect, Connect, Debug, Command
- `lib/` — types.ts, constants.ts, game-state.ts, game-context.tsx, audio.ts
- `lib/data/` — planets.ts, missions.ts, crew.ts, items.ts, academy.ts

## Memory Files
- `tech-stack.md` — Stack details, colors, typography, critical gotchas
- `game-systems.md` — Stats, ranks, missions, crew, inventory mechanics
- `content-mapping.md` — Every planet, every mission, content sources for Phase 6
- `user-preferences.md` — Build style, git policy, hosting, timeline
- `project-overview.md` — Narrative arc, audience, metaphors

## Current State (as of Phase 7 completion)
- **Phases 1-7 COMPLETE** — Scaffolding, Infrastructure, Core Screens, Game Systems, Mini-Games, Planet Content, Academy
- **24 commits, ~14,500 lines of code, 32 agent invocations, 0 type errors**
- **Next: Phase 8** — Polish (page transitions, audio, responsive, visual assets)

## What's Built
- Title screen, character creation, cockpit HUD, star map, navigation bar
- Dialogue system, mission framework (4-phase: briefing→learning→challenge→debrief)
- Inventory & crew pages
- 5 mini-games: PromptDuel, Architect, Connect, Debug, Command
- All game state in localStorage via React context
- **34 missions fully populated** — dialogue trees, learning blocks, challenge data for all 8 planets
- **10 Academy sections** — AI IDEs, code review, no-code, agent SDKs, Claude Code, best practices, MCP workshop, resources, how-built, career paths
- Academy landing page + section template with 7 content block renderers
- Challenge phase wired to mini-games via `renderChallenge()` in mission page

## What's Left
- **Phase 8:** Polish (page transitions, audio integration, responsive, visual assets)
- **Phase 9:** Vercel deployment at [REDACTED_DOMAIN]

## Key Architecture
- Mission data in `lib/data/missions.ts` — 34 missions with content merged from planet files
- Planet content files at `lib/data/missions/[planetId].ts` export `Record<string, MissionContent>`
- Academy content files at `lib/data/academy/[sectionId].ts` export `AcademyContentBlock[]`
- Academy index at `lib/data/academy/index.ts` — `getSectionContent(sectionId)` lookup
- Mini-games accept `onComplete(score: 0-100)` and are wired via mission `challengeType`
- Mission page `renderChallenge()` switches on challengeType to render correct mini-game

## File Map
- `app/` — pages (page.tsx, create/, cockpit/, starmap/, planets/[planetId]/, inventory/, crew/, academy/, academy/[sectionId]/)
- `components/ui/` — 7 reusable components (GlassPanel, Button, StarfieldBackground, TypewriterText, StatGauge, XPBar)
- `components/game/` — DialogueSystem, MissionBriefing, LearningPhase, MissionDebrief, NavBar, StarMap
- `components/games/` — PromptDuel, Architect, Connect, Debug, Command
- `lib/` — types.ts, constants.ts, game-state.ts, game-context.tsx, audio.ts
- `lib/data/` — planets.ts, missions.ts, crew.ts, items.ts, academy.ts
- `lib/data/missions/` — vibe-world.ts, debt-belt.ts, mcp-station.ts, agent-academy.ts, framework-nebula.ts, orchestration-citadel.ts, security-fortress.ts, production-worlds.ts
- `lib/data/academy/` — types.ts, index.ts, ai-ides.ts, code-review.ts, no-code.ts, agent-sdks.ts, claude-code.ts, best-practices.ts, mcp-workshop.ts, resources.ts, how-built.ts, career-paths.ts
